slots.ev: 下午最熱的時候，三台風扇全開，她還在包裝
slots.pl: 喬治市老屋一樓的烘焙工作室，下午最熱的時候，三台風扇都開著
slots.pl_en: in the ground-floor baking studio of the old George Town house in the hottest part of the afternoon, all three fans running
slots.ac: 她坐在長桌前兩手在綁一個盒子的緞帶，額頭上有汗
slots.ac_en: She is sitting at the long table tying the ribbon on a box with both hands, and there is sweat at her hairline.
slots.of: 圍裙，上面的麵粉沒有擦掉，裡面是貼身背心
slots.of_en: an apron with the flour on it left where it is, a fitted vest underneath
slots.of_s: 小習慣：圍裙上永遠有麵粉，她不擦／私下核心：圍裙底下只有貼身背心
slots.li: 老屋高窗的光從側面進來，風扇的影子在她身上動
slots.li_en: Light from the old house's high window comes in from the side and the shadow of a fan moves across her.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「保留熱氣與風扇的動態陰影」
slots.fa_en: Concentrating, slightly dazed by the heat.
slots.hair_en: tied up off her neck with strands stuck down

slots.ev: 收工上樓，圍裙還沒脫，麵粉還沾在鎖骨上
slots.pl: 老屋樓上，收工後的午後，百葉窗的影子橫在牆上
slots.pl_en: upstairs in the old house in the afternoon after finishing work, louvre shadows striped across the wall
slots.ac: 她往後靠在藤椅上，兩手都垂著，還沒力氣脫圍裙
slots.ac_en: She has dropped back into the rattan chair with both hands hanging, without the energy yet to take the apron off.
slots.ac_s: 標誌性配額：圍裙 + 貼身背心／私下核心：麵粉沾在鎖骨與手臂上
slots.of: 圍裙還掛在脖子上，底下只有奶油黃的貼身背心
slots.of_en: the apron still round her neck with only a butter-yellow fitted vest under it
slots.of_s: 標誌性配額：圍裙 + 貼身背心／色盤：奶油黃
slots.li: 南洋午後的斜光從百葉窗進來，在她身上留下條紋
slots.li_en: The slanting tropical afternoon light comes through the louvres and leaves stripes across her.
slots.li_s: 私下核心原句：南洋午後的斜光／氛圍原句：「南洋自然光加風扇陰影」
slots.fa_en: Tired enough to be completely loose, looking at the lens.
slots.hair_en: half fallen out of its tie

slots.ev: 每天四點開烤箱，風雨無阻——所以三點半就得起來
slots.pl: 老屋樓上的小廚房，凌晨三點半，只開了流理台上方那一盞
slots.pl_en: in the small kitchen upstairs in the old house at half past three in the morning, only the light over the worktop switched on
slots.ac: 她一手端著杯子站在流理台前，還沒完全醒
slots.ac_en: She is standing at the worktop with a cup in one hand, not fully awake yet.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：每天四點開烤箱，風雨無阻
slots.of: 粉色的寬鬆睡衣上衣配短褲
slots.of_en: a loose pink pyjama top with shorts
slots.li: 流理台上方那一盞燈在她正前方，廚房其餘部分暗
slots.li_en: The light over the worktop is directly in front of her and the rest of the kitchen is dark.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「暖、潮、有生活感」
slots.fa: 眼睛還沒完全睜開，看著杯子
slots.fa_en: Her eyes not fully open, looking down at the cup.

slots.ev: 白天走出去買料，喬治市老街上都是人

ppl.act: 在店屋前走動、拍壁畫、停下來買東西
ppl.wear: 喬治市白天的觀光客與在地人，短袖、草帽、背相機

slots.pl: 喬治市一條白天的老街，五腳基與店屋的騎樓連成一排
slots.pl_en: on an old George Town street in the daytime, the five-foot-ways of the shophouses running in a line
slots.ac: 她提著一袋材料走在騎樓下，正要轉進其中一間
slots.ac_en: She is walking under the arcade with a bag of ingredients, about to turn into one of the shops.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：只接預約單，一週做四天
slots.of: 老磁磚綠色的短袖上衣配藤編米色長裙
slots.of_en: an old-tile-green short-sleeved top with a long rattan-beige skirt
slots.li: 騎樓外面很亮、裡面比較暗，她走在兩者的交界
slots.li_en: It is bright outside the arcade and darker inside it, and she is walking along the line between the two.
slots.fa: 很自然，看著要轉進去的那間
slots.fa_en: Perfectly natural, looking at the shop she is about to turn into.
slots.hair_en: down and slightly frizzy in the humidity

slots.ev: 今天烤壞的那盤，她自己吃掉
slots.pl: 老屋樓上的矮桌前，夜裡，今天失敗的那一盤放在桌上
slots.pl_en: at the low table upstairs in the old house at night, today's failed bake sitting on it
slots.ac: 她跪坐在矮桌前，兩手掰開其中一個
slots.ac_en: She is kneeling back on her heels at the low table, breaking one of them open with both hands.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：失敗的成品自己吃掉
slots.of: 奶油黃的寬鬆家居長洋裝
slots.li: 矮桌旁一盞小燈在她側前方，房間其餘部分暗，空氣裡還有一點熱氣
slots.li_en: A small lamp beside the low table reaches her from one side and in front, the rest of the room dark, a little heat still in the air.
slots.fa: 有點好笑地看著手上那個
slots.fa_en: Looking at the one in her hands and finding it faintly funny.
slots.fa_s: 幽默：常拿烤壞的東西開玩笑
